topic: Reviewing frame attributes and data discrepancies
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on discrepancies in frame attributes, specifically regarding a static type listed as digital in the import table versus the actual frame data. The need to re-verify all attributes was raised due to format changes in the source tables.

[me] stated that only FrameID updates were completed for one item, and updating other parameters is complex because of repeated format changes. [me] suspected a filter might be causing missing data, suggesting it should be removed for a full update.

It was determined that filtering by the client may not be appropriate as many frames are missing from the list when filtered. The final check confirmed that some frame data had been deleted or excluded.
decisions: The need to re-verify all attributes and potentially reload them is acknowledged.
A full update of FrameID will be attempted by tomorrow afternoon.
action_items: [me] to attempt updating all frame IDs by approximately 4 PM the next day.
Someone (the 'unknown' participant) to follow up with the client regarding the missing/deleted frame data.
